target_sync_rule: After a completed episode and after any update, sync if replay length>64 and global steps since last sync>50; never sync inside an unfinished episode
loss: Original four-output MSE with target-network anchors for unchosen actions; vectorized common implementation verified against original optimizer before formal training
bootstrap: Only WIN has no bootstrap; original LOSE timeout still bootstraps
budget_cut: Stop exactly at 200000 transitions. If episode unfinished, record BUDGET_CUT but retain its PLAYING transition label; do not perform episode-end optimization, epsilon decay or target sync
random_streams: Identical initial torch seeds across arms. Independent numpy RandomState(seed) exploration gates, random.Random(200000+seed) exploratory actions, random.Random(300000+seed) replay draws, numpy default_rng(100000+seed) episode reset seeds. Author reset reseeding cannot perturb local action/replay generators
shared_adaptations: Common batched numerical implementation of original optimizer, checked for targets, losses, gradients and Adam parameters; floating point batching may differ from scalar source
Independent action and replay RNGs in both arms; same distributions as public routine, not identical historical source trajectories
Fixed environment-step budget and no convergence-based early stopping
Final budget cut is censoring, not an environment terminal
changed_factor: Whether one gradient update is scheduled after each post-warmup transition or only after a completed episode
comparison_scope: Same environment interaction budget, not same optimizer count or wall time. Episode counts and realized epsilon can differ as a consequence of different trajectories under the same episode-indexed rule
evaluation: Save all six budget-final models before their evaluation; score each from all61 hotel starts and both paper starts; preserve every failure, no best checkpoint selection
acceptance_reporting: Report arrival counts, blocked/cycle counts, invalid actions, paper-route matches, optimizer count and completed episodes per arm and seed; no significance claim or extrapolation beyond this hotel
stop_rule: Six finite runs only; per-run900-second hard cap; retain interrupted runs without automatic retries or adaptive hyperparameter changes
